plugins.name: jurimetria-lab
plugins.description: Jurimetric research on French legal-decision corpora. Experiments, per-decision reviews, cohort resolution, rapport synthesis, and new-module launches — chunk-cited, French-audited, bound to the Themia and Veriguard MCP servers.

plugins.name: croissance-lab
plugins.description: Growth and distribution for Themia. Positioning, discovery, channels, French legal copy, webinar production, plus eleven founder-playbook frameworks. Where jurimetria-lab produces the verified truth, croissance-lab distributes it.

plugins.name: leadership-lab
plugins.description: How Themia is run. Operational capture (bugs, ideas, decisions → Linear), day-open agenda, runway/cashflow snapshots, Freedom & Responsibility culture model, and procès-verbaux for décisions collectives des associés.

plugins.name: engineering-lab
plugins.description: How Themia ships. Shaping, PR review, develop-to-main promotion, Playwright E2E, leggia Python toolchain, and the engineering-router that dispatches across the practice's skills. Owns methods, calls universal skills — never vendors them.
